class Base {
  static #tag = 8;
  static read(value: typeof Base | { other: number }): number {
    if (#tag in value) return value.#tag;
    return "other" in value ? value.other : 0;
  }
  static exact(value: typeof Base): number {
    if (#tag in value) return value.#tag;
    const impossible: never = value;
    return impossible;
  }
}
class Derived extends Base {
  static extra = true;
}
class PrivateOnly {
  static #tag = 3;
}
class Unrelated {}
const constructorValue: typeof PrivateOnly = Unrelated;
console.log(Base.read(Base), Base.read(Derived), Base.read({ other: 5 }), Base.exact(Base), constructorValue === Unrelated);
